name: Raene Wolfrunner
summary: In Astranaar, Raene Wolfrunner directs the Sentinels’ defense of Ashenvale. Her wolf and saber cat companions stay close as she faces Horde forces and corrupted furbolg tribes.

sections.title: Defender of Astranaar
sections.body: Raene Wolfrunner keeps watch in Astranaar with Korra, her saber cat, and Dagri, her wolf. A Sentinel officer, she oversees patrols across Ashenvale and coordinates intelligence from beyond the forest. She sends scouts such as Kaela Shadowspear into neighboring regions, including the Stonetalon Mountains.

sections.title: Stemming the Forest's Corruption
sections.body: Raene also works to counter the corruption sickening Ashenvale’s native denizens. She directs campaigns against hostile furbolg tribes, including strikes on Foulweald camps that harass travelers and efforts to remove rising Thistlefur leaders. Her scouts watch for changes in furbolg behavior. Under Raene’s command, they protect local settlements and passing travelers from coordinated ambushes.

sections.title: Dartol's Rod
sections.body: Raene’s personal cause is Dartol’s Rod, an ancient relic tied to furbolg purification. Her longtime friend Teronis was slain while seeking its missing gemstone. Raene ordered his body recovered and pledged to complete his research. With the dryad Shael'dryn, she helps champions assemble the relic. It lets an adventurer take furbolg guise and speak with chieftain Krolg, then defeat the tainted leader Ran Bloodtooth and purge the regional threat.

faq.q: Where can Raene Wolfrunner be found?
faq.answer: Raene Wolfrunner is in Astranaar, Ashenvale’s central night elf town. She stands outdoors with her two animal companions.

faq.q: Who are the animals standing next to Raene?
faq.answer: Raene’s companions are Korra, a saber cat, and Dagri, a wolf. Both stay beside her in Astranaar.

faq.q: What is Raene's role within the Sentinels?
faq.answer: Raene is a ranking Sentinel officer in central Ashenvale. She issues orders to scouts, manages outposts, and coordinates operations against local threats.

faq.q: What happened to Raene's friend Teronis?
faq.answer: Teronis was seeking a gemstone needed for Dartol’s Rod when he was slain in the field. Raene arranged to recover his remains and complete his mission.

faq.q: Why is Raene focusing so heavily on the furbolgs?
faq.answer: Corrupted furbolg tribes such as the Foulweald and Thistlefur have grown more aggressive. They ambush travelers on forest roads and threaten Astranaar’s stability.

faq.q: What is the purpose of Dartol's Rod in her questline?
faq.answer: Dartol’s Rod lets an adventurer take furbolg form and speak with Krolg. This opens the way to confront the corrupt chieftain Ran Bloodtooth.

angles.text: For Alliance travelers from Darkshore, Raene coordinates Ashenvale’s military and ecological defense.
As a night elf, you can see Raene’s dedication to Elune and Kalimdor’s wilderness in her defense of Ashenvale’s woodland sanctuaries.
As a hunter, you may recognize Raene’s mastery of the wilderness and bond with beasts. She commands a wolf and a saber cat.
